items.title: NoiTox: A Machine Learning Strategy for Peptide Toxicity Prediction Reveals Label Noise in Benchmark Datasets
items.abstract_or_text: Motivation: Peptide toxicity remains a major bottleneck in drug development, as small sequence variations can drastically alter cytotoxic profiles. Experimental assessment is costly and time-consuming, motivating computational predictors. Existing approaches often rely on single black-box architectures, limiting interpretability and obscuring the contribution of individual sequence features. Furthermore, benchmark datasets frequently define the negative class through annotation filters rather than direct experimental evidence, introducing structural label noise that can compromises training and evaluation. Results: We present NoiTox, a multi-model strategy for peptide toxicity prediction integrating three complementary architectures, evaluated as four model variants: NoiToxML (Bo/full), an Extremely Randomized Trees classifier with Boruta-selected or complete physicochemical, compositional, and atomic descriptors; NoiToxDP, a deep learning model leveraging ESM-2 protein language model embeddings; and NoiToxGP, a graph neural network that combines ESM-2 residue embeddings, a fully connected residue graph with attention, and the Boruta descriptors as global features. Averaged over five random seeds, the models approached the state-of-the-art predictor ToxiPep on CD-HIT-controlled test sets, and on an independent dataset the interpretable NoiToxML variants and a probability-averaging consensus of the four models exceeded it, showing that physicochemical descriptors are highly informative for toxicity prediction. Cross-referencing negative-labeled sequences against curated databases of hemolytic, cytotoxic, and neurotoxic peptides flagged a small set annotated as toxic elsewhere, consistent with label noise by omission. However, removing the sequences that all models contradicted did not improve, and for some models reduced, ranking performance, indicating that such sequences carry useful information and are better treated as candidates for curation than discarded automatically. Availability and implementation: https://github.com/goalmeida05/NoiTox.
items.summary_zh: 提出 NoiTox 多模型肽毒性预测策略，结合 Boruta 理化/组成/原子描述符、ESM-2 嵌入和图神经网络，并系统评估基准数据中的标签噪声。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时比较可解释模型、蛋白语言模型和图模型，并在独立数据集上验证；揭示“负类”可能含有未标注毒性序列。需要注意的是，性能仍依赖数据集构造和 CD-HIT 控制，标签清理不能简单依赖模型排除。
items.abstract_zh: 动机：肽毒性仍是药物开发的主要瓶颈，因为序列的微小变化可能大幅改变细胞毒性谱。实验评估成本高且耗时，因而需要计算预测器。现有方法往往依赖单一黑箱架构，限制了可解释性，也掩盖了单个序列特征的贡献。此外，基准数据集经常通过注释过滤而非直接实验依据来定义负类，从而引入会损害训练和评估的结构性标签噪声。结果：我们提出 NoiTox，一种整合三类互补架构的肽毒性预测策略，并评估了四种模型变体：NoiToxML (Bo/full) 是使用 Boruta 筛选或完整的理化、组成和原子描述符的 Extremely Randomized Trees 分类器；NoiToxDP 是利用 ESM-2 蛋白语言模型嵌入的深度学习模型；NoiToxGP 是图神经网络，将 ESM-2 残基嵌入、带注意力的全连接残基图以及作为全局特征的 Boruta 描述符结合起来。在五个随机种子上取平均后，这些模型在 CD-HIT 控制的测试集上接近最先进的预测器 ToxiPep；在独立数据集上，可解释的 NoiToxML 变体和四个模型的概率平均共识超过了该预测器，表明理化描述符对毒性预测很有信息量。将负类标记序列与经过整理的溶血性、细胞毒性和神经毒性肽数据库交叉比对后，发现有少量序列在其他数据库中被标注为有毒，这与遗漏造成的标签噪声一致。然而，移除所有模型都判定不一致的序列并未改善排序性能，且对部分模型反而降低了性能，说明这些序列包含有用信息，更适合作为待整理候选，而不应自动丢弃。可用性与实现：https://github.com/goalmeida05/NoiTox。
items.author_line: Almeida, G. O., Albuquerque, M. C., Silva, B. M., Silva, O. A. B., Ferreira, R. S., Meira, W., Pires, D. V., Prata, W. M., Silveira, S. A.

items.title: Protein Deimmunization with a Generative Diffusion Model
items.abstract_or_text: Protein immunogenicity is a major cause of biologic drug failure, leading to the production of anti-drug antibodies (ADA) that accelerate drug clearance, rejection of repeated doses, abolished efficacy, and sometimes life threatening anaphylaxis in patients. These responses constrain the clinical use of synthetic protein therapeutics from non-human origin. To efficiently deimmunize protein therapeutics, we developed a generative discrete diffusion model (MESSI), which takes protein structures as input and outputs sequences that preserve structure without containing peptides predicted to bind major histocompatibility complex class II molecules. MESSI designs sequences with high structural recovery and down to 0 predicted epitopes for specified MHC molecules at higher efficiency than post-hoc filtering approaches. Experimentally, we first applied MESSI to deimmunize a luciferase and a de novo designed mini-binder against PD-1, resulting in variants with no predicted epitopes and higher activity than their parents. Lastly, we coupled MESSI with evolution guidance to deimmunize uricase, a clinically approved enzyme with severe immunogenicity, and found deimmunized variants with higher catalytic activity than their natural orthologs. MESSI enables generative design of functional proteins with minimized immunogenicity, potentially making protein therapeutics safer and more effective.
items.summary_zh: 开发生成式离散扩散模型 MESSI，以蛋白质结构为输入设计保留结构、降低 MHC-II 预测表位的蛋白序列，并在 luciferase、PD-1 mini-binder 和 uricase 上进行验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把去免疫化与结构保持、功能优化统一到生成式设计中，并给出蛋白和小鼠相关实验验证。限制在于免疫原性主要依据预测表位衡量，仍需更广泛的免疫学和临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质免疫原性是生物药物失败的主要原因之一，会导致产生抗药物抗体（ADA），从而加速药物清除、引发重复给药排斥、使疗效消失，有时还会在患者中造成危及生命的过敏性休克。这些反应限制了非人源合成蛋白疗法的临床使用。为了高效地对蛋白质疗法进行去免疫化，我们开发了生成式离散扩散模型 MESSI。该模型以蛋白质结构为输入，输出保持结构且不含预测会结合主要组织相容性复合体 II 类分子的肽段的序列。与事后过滤方法相比，MESSI 能以更高效率设计出结构恢复度高、针对指定 MHC 分子预测表位数低至 0 的序列。在实验中，我们首先将 MESSI 用于 luciferase 和从头设计的靶向 PD-1 的 mini-binder 的去免疫化，得到预测表位为 0 且活性高于亲本的变体。最后，我们将 MESSI 与进化引导结合，对临床批准但免疫原性严重的酶 uricase 进行去免疫化，并发现催化活性高于其天然直系同源物的去免疫化变体。MESSI 可生成免疫原性降低且具有功能的蛋白质，有望使蛋白质疗法更安全、更有效。
items.author_line: Chen, Z., Yu, C.-c., Zhou, C., Jiang, X., Nguyen, L., Myhrvold, C., Jaakkola, T. S., Jiang, K.

items.title: Programmable design of functional RNAs through multimodal generative learning
items.abstract_or_text: RNA engineering is bottlenecked by the tight coupling among sequence, structure, and function, leaving the field reliant on heuristics or screening. We introduce RNAverse, a multimodal generative model that learns a conditionable design grammar from RNA sequences, experimental structural probing profiles, and functional annotations. Beyond setting a new state of the art across 16 predictive modeling tasks, RNAverse inverts into generative design across four distinct RNA classes through three regimes, requiring experimental testing of no more than 20 candidates per-task. Zero-shot in-painting generates snoRNAs that promote premature termination codon (PTC) readthrough, and chimeric aptazymes for ligand-controlled gene regulation, exceeding rational design or large-scale screens. In both settings, RNAverse outperforms family-adapted sequence-only baselines. Fine-tuned in-painting extends to an unseen functional class, yielding IGFBP3-binding aptamers with picomolar affinity that outperform SELEX winners. Iterative optimization engineers 5' UTRs that outperform clinical benchmarks, enhancing protein production in cell-based assays for both the Zolgensma gene therapy and the BNT162b2 COVID-19 vaccine, and boosting antibody responses to BNT162b2 in mice. Together, these results establish multimodal generative learning as a route from predictive RNA modeling to programmable specification of functional RNAs.
items.summary_zh: 提出 RNAverse 多模态生成模型，从 RNA 序列、实验结构探测谱和功能注释学习可条件化设计语法，并在多类 RNA、5' UTR、基因治疗和疫苗相关场景中进行生成与实验测试。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将序列、结构和功能联合建模，并以每项不超过20个候选的实验测试覆盖多种 RNA 设计任务；但部分结果依赖特定细胞体系和小鼠模型，临床可迁移性仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: RNA 工程受到序列、结构和功能之间紧密耦合的限制，使该领域仍依赖启发式方法或筛选。我们提出 RNAverse，这是一种多模态生成模型，从 RNA 序列、实验结构探测谱和功能注释中学习可条件化的设计语法。除在 16 个预测建模任务上达到新的 state of the art 外，RNAverse 还在三种模式下对四类不同 RNA 进行生成式设计，每项任务所需的实验测试候选数不超过 20 个。零样本 in-painting 生成了促进提前终止密码子（PTC）通读的 snoRNA，以及用于配体控制基因调控的嵌合 aptazyme，效果超过理性设计或大规模筛选。在这两种设置中，RNAverse 都优于针对 RNA 家族适配的仅序列基线。微调后的 in-painting 还能扩展到未见过的功能类别，产生与 IGFBP3 结合且具有皮摩尔级亲和力的 aptamer，性能超过 SELEX 获胜序列。迭代优化设计的 5' UTR 超过临床基准，在细胞实验中提高了 Zolgensma 基因治疗和 BNT162b2 COVID-19 疫苗的蛋白质产量，并在小鼠中增强了对 BNT162b2 的抗体反应。总体而言，这些结果表明，多模态生成学习可以将 RNA 预测建模推进到功能 RNA 的可编程规范设计。
items.author_line: Ma, J., Zhu, J., Huang, W., Mu, K., Huang, K., Dong, Z., Guo, F., Xie, X., Shao, Y., Huber, R., Wan, Y., Zhang, L., Wu, Q., Zhang, Q. C.

items.title: Whole-Enzyme Reactive Free-Energy Simulations with a Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potential: Catalytic Mechanism and Mutational Effects of PETase
items.abstract_or_text: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) have emerged as powerful tools for atomistic simulations that achieve quantum mechanical accuracy at significantly reduced computational cost. Yet, their direct application to complex enzymatic reactions remains challenging owing to the immense size of solvated enzyme systems and the scarcity of transition-state structures in training data. In this study, we demonstrate that PFP (PreFerred Potential), a pretrained uMLIP across 96 elements in nature, simulates the complete hydrolytic cycle of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) catalyzed by PETase as a single reactive domain of approximately 20,000 atoms, without multiscale partitioning or system-specific fine-tuning. Umbrella-sampling simulations revealed stepwise mechanisms for both acylation and deacylation through distinct tetrahedral intermediates. The computed rate-limiting deacylation barrier of 20.5 ± 0.3 kcal/mol is in agreement with the range of 18.0–18.7 kcal/mol inferred from experimental turnover numbers. The PFP-based simulations further capture catalytic consequences of point mutations from loss of function (D177N, M132A) to predicted activity enhancement (D157N) and reveal that simultaneous neutralization of three distal acidic residues which are located more than 10 Å from the active site raises the activation barrier due to a collective long-range electrostatic effect that emerges naturally in the partition-free treatment. These findings demonstrate that the pretrained uMLIP, PFP, can provide physically plausible free-energy profiles for enzymatic reaction mechanisms and capture mutational effects, providing a powerful platform for rational enzyme design.
items.summary_zh: 利用预训练通用机器学习原子间势 PFP，在约20,000原子的完整 PETase 体系中进行 PET 水解反应自由能模拟，解析催化步骤、突变效应和远程静电作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了无需多尺度分区或体系专门微调的全酶反应模拟，并将计算势垒与实验周转数据及突变效应联系起来。局限是结果仍来自特定酶和模型势，其他酶体系的可靠性需要独立基准验证。
items.abstract_zh: 通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIP）已成为原子级模拟的有力工具，能够以显著较低的计算成本达到量子力学精度。然而，由于溶剂化酶体系规模巨大且训练数据中过渡态结构稀缺，它们直接应用于复杂酶反应仍具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们证明预训练的 uMLIP——覆盖自然界中 96 种元素的 PFP (PreFerred Potential)——能够将聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）降解酶 PETase 的完整水解循环作为一个约 20,000 个原子的单一反应域进行模拟，无需多尺度分区或针对体系的微调。伞形采样模拟揭示了酰化和去酰化均经由不同四面体中间体的分步机制。计算得到的限速去酰化势垒为 20.5 ± 0.3 kcal/mol，与由实验周转数推断的 18.0–18.7 kcal/mol 范围一致。基于 PFP 的模拟还捕捉到点突变从功能丧失（D177N、M132A）到预测活性增强（D157N）的催化后果，并显示同时中和三个距离活性位点超过 10 Å 的远端酸性残基会提高活化势垒；这种效应源于分区自由处理自然产生的集体长程静电作用。这些结果表明，预训练 uMLIP PFP 能够为酶反应机制提供物理上合理的自由能剖面并捕捉突变效应，为理性酶设计提供有力平台。

items.title: Machine Learning Identifies an Information-Sufficiency Regime for Critical-Mineral Recovery
items.abstract_or_text: The recovery of critical minerals from spent lithium-ion batteries is governed by coupled feedstock chemistry, solvent composition, and processing conditions, yet heterogeneous experimental reporting makes it difficult to determine which information is essential for reliable prediction across heterogeneous experimental systems. Here, using deep eutectic solvent-based recovery as a representative resource recovery platform, we curate 814 experimental observations from 38 publications and develop an interpretable machine learning framework to identify an informationsufficiency regime. Five descriptors, including temperature, electrode material type, leaching time, target metal, and hydrogen-bond donor identity, retain 98.3% of the predictive performance of the full 13-descriptor model while reducing the descriptor space by 61.5%. Reducing the representation from five to four descriptors causes a pronounced performance loss, whereas adding a sixth provides negligible additional benefit. Descriptor removal and domain ablation analyses further show that temperature and target metal identity contain the least replaceable predictive information, while material identity, solvent chemistry, and processing conditions provide complementary information. These results identify a compact, chemically structured information core for critical-mineral recovery and provide a quantitative basis for prioritizing experimental measurements, improving cross-study data consistency, and developing more transferable datadriven frameworks for battery resource recovery.
items.summary_zh: 整理38篇文献中的814条深共熔溶剂回收实验记录，利用可解释机器学习识别关键描述符，将模型输入从13个压缩到5个而保留98.3%的预测性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为废旧锂离子电池关键矿物回收确定了紧凑的信息核心，可帮助优先设计实验和提高跨研究数据一致性。结论来自文献汇编数据，跨实验体系的外推和因果解释仍需谨慎。
items.abstract_zh: 废旧锂离子电池中关键矿物的回收受原料化学、溶剂组成和工艺条件的耦合控制，但实验报告的异质性使人们难以确定哪些信息对于跨异质实验体系的可靠预测是必需的。在本研究中，我们以深共熔溶剂回收作为代表性资源回收平台，整理了来自 38 篇出版物的 814 条实验观测，并开发可解释的机器学习框架来识别信息充分性区间。包括温度、电极材料类型、浸出时间、目标金属和氢键供体身份在内的五个描述符，在将描述符空间减少 61.5% 的同时，保留了完整 13 描述符模型 98.3% 的预测性能。将表示从五个描述符减少到四个会导致性能显著下降，而增加第六个描述符几乎没有额外收益。描述符移除和领域消融分析进一步表明，温度和目标金属身份包含最难替代的预测信息，而材料身份、溶剂化学和工艺条件提供互补信息。这些结果确定了关键矿物回收中一个紧凑且具有化学结构的信息核心，并为优先安排实验测量、改善跨研究数据一致性以及开发更具可迁移性的电池资源回收数据驱动框架提供定量依据。
items.author_line: Tengxiao Liu, Ta-Wei Wang, Hongtao Sun

items.title: Dual-graph deconvolution of enzyme fitness: an interpretable framework to identify and explain catalytic modulators
items.abstract_or_text: Models trained on protein sequences can predict mutational effects, but their outputs represent a convolution of different phenotypes. Isolating stability-independent activity effects is essential for rational enzyme design, allosteric drug design and functional annotation, yet existing pLM-based deconvolution methods lack interpretability. Here, we introduce a hybrid framework that pairs stability predictors with probabilistic graphical models of coevolution. Benchmarked on all enzymes with available multidimensional deep mutational scanning data, our framework isolates stability-independent activity effects with a fidelity that matches analogous pLM-based approaches. Crucially, we reveal biophysically plausible communication pathways that align with previous knowledge and that we validate with experimental data across a diverse set of targets. This hybrid approach merges statistical and geometric deep learning into a zero-shot, explainable tool for targeted engineering and mechanistic discovery.
items.summary_zh: 构建结合稳定性预测器与共进化概率图模型的双图框架，从多维深度突变扫描数据中分离与稳定性无关的酶活性效应，并用实验验证潜在通信路径。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提升了酶突变效应解释性，可服务于酶工程、变构药物设计和功能注释；但方法表现主要在已有多维扫描数据覆盖的酶上验证，零样本泛化范围仍需评估。
items.abstract_zh: 基于蛋白质序列训练的模型可以预测突变效应，但其输出是不同表型的卷积。分离与稳定性无关的活性效应对于理性酶设计、变构药物设计和功能注释至关重要；然而，现有基于 pLM 的去卷积方法缺乏可解释性。在此，我们提出一种混合框架，将稳定性预测器与共进化的概率图模型结合起来。在所有具有多维深度突变扫描数据的酶上进行基准评估时，我们的框架以与类似 pLM 方法相当的保真度分离出与稳定性无关的活性效应。更重要的是，我们揭示了具有生物物理合理性的通信路径，这些路径与既有认识一致，并在多个不同靶标上通过实验数据得到验证。这一混合方法融合了统计和几何深度学习，形成一种用于定向工程和机制发现的零样本、可解释工具。
items.author_line: Garcia Busto, S., Eschbach, E., Hopf, T. A., Sander, C., Bacallado, S., Marks, D. S.

items.title: Spatial Tumour Tissue Distribution Dynamics of a Bicycle Peptide-MMAE Toxin Conjugate Profiled by Targeted Mass Spectrometry
items.abstract_or_text: A highly specific-NECTIN-4 binding bicyclic peptide covalently linked to the cytotoxin monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE) via a valine-citrulline cleavable linker (zelenectide pevedotin, BT8009) is a promising modality to treat cancer patients with solid tumours. Although the pharmacokinetics and biodistribution of zelenectide pevedotin have been well characterised, a more precise view of tumour delivery and intra-tumoural distribution of its released payload is lacking. To address this, we have developed an approach to profile the spatial tumour and healthy tissue distribution of this anti-cancer agent using laser capture microdissection coupled to targeted liquid chromatography parallel reaction monitoring (LCM-LC-PRM) mass spectrometry. This LCM-assisted spatial pharmacology workflow enables the precise isolation of specific tissue regions, followed by high-resolution analysis of MMAE distribution at sub-tissue-specific levels. By identifying and optimising MS/MS-specific fragmentation ions for accurate and sensitive detection and quantitation of MMAE released from zelenectide pevedotin within tumour tissues, we observed progressive accumulation and sustained retention of MMAE in mouse tumour tissues over a period of 24 h. Conversely, in plasma, liver and muscle tissues, MMAE levels generally declined following early exposure, although inter-animal variability was observed. LCM-based intra-tumour spatial profiling revealed heterogeneous MMAE distribution between tumour cell-rich and stroma-rich regions, with distinct temporal patterns across compartments. Together, our spatial targeted MS method provided valuable insights into zelenectide pevedotin's payload distribution dynamics in vivo, thereby enhancing our understanding of its therapeutic potential and guiding the development of next-generation Bicycle Drug Conjugate (BDC).
items.summary_zh: 建立激光捕获显微切割结合靶向 LC-PRM 质谱的空间药理流程，解析 zelenectide pevedotin（BT8009）释放的 MMAE 在小鼠肿瘤及健康组织中的时空分布。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把药物偶联物有效载荷的组织分布推进到亚组织尺度，发现肿瘤细胞富集区与基质富集区的异质性。当前证据来自小鼠和单一偶联物，人与不同肿瘤类型中的可重复性尚未确定。
items.abstract_zh: 一种高度特异性结合 NECTIN-4 的双环肽通过可被 valine-citrulline 切割的连接子与细胞毒素 monomethyl auristatin E（MMAE）共价连接，形成 zelenectide pevedotin（BT8009）；这是治疗实体瘤患者的一种有前景的治疗形式。尽管 zelenectide pevedotin 的药代动力学和生物分布已经得到充分表征，但对于其释放载荷在肿瘤中的递送及肿瘤内分布，还缺乏更精确的认识。为此，我们开发了一种方法，利用激光捕获显微切割结合靶向液相色谱平行反应监测（LCM-LC-PRM）质谱，对该抗癌药物在肿瘤和健康组织中的空间分布进行分析。该显微切割辅助的空间药理流程能够精确分离特定组织区域，随后以亚组织特异性尺度高分辨率分析 MMAE 的分布。通过识别并优化用于在肿瘤组织中准确、灵敏检测和定量 zelenectide pevedotin 释放的 MMAE 的 MS/MS 特异性碎片离子，我们观察到 MMAE 在小鼠肿瘤组织中持续 24 h 渐进积累并保持。相反，在血浆、肝脏和肌肉组织中，MMAE 水平通常在早期暴露后下降，但动物间存在差异。基于 LCM 的肿瘤内空间分析显示，MMAE 在肿瘤细胞富集区和基质富集区之间分布不均一，并且不同区室具有不同的时间模式。总之，我们的空间靶向质谱方法为理解 zelenectide pevedotin 的载荷在体内的分布动力学提供了有价值的见解，并有助于指导下一代 Bicycle Drug Conjugate（BDC）的开发。
items.author_line: Ioannidi, M.-K., Davis, S., He, T., Hester, S., Rigby, M., Holding, F., Jeffrey, P., Skynner, M., Vendrell, I., Fischer, R., Kessler, B. M.

items.title: RetroMol: Knowledge Distillation of Energy-Based Retrosynthesis Models
items.abstract_or_text: Retrosynthesis prediction is a central task in computer-aided synthesis planning, and synthesizability remains a persistent bottleneck in AI-driven molecular and materials discovery. We introduce RetroMol, a family of compact text-based models that transfers an energy-based critic’s ranking of candidate reactant sets into the generator itself. RetroBase, an 11M-parameter transformer encoderdecoder trained on two-reactant USPTO reactions, achieves Top-1 and Top-5 accuracies of 46.8% and 67.8% on a held-out test split. RetroERM, an energybased model over molecular fingerprint counts, scores RetroBase’s candidates, and its ranking preferences are distilled back into the generator. The distilled model, RetroDistil, reaches 52.6% Top-1 and 73.5% Top-5 under identical data and evaluation, improving on RetroBase by 5.7–6.8 points at Top-1/3/5 with no reranking stage at inference and no increase in model size. Distilling a critic is therefore a practical way to improve a compact retrosynthesis generator without larger or more complicated architectures.
items.summary_zh: 提出 RetroMol 紧凑型逆合成模型，通过将能量模型对候选反应物集合的排序偏好蒸馏回生成器，在不增加模型规模或推理重排序阶段的情况下提升 USPTO 测试准确率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 说明能量型批评器的知识可直接改善小型逆合成生成器，兼顾性能和部署成本。评估仅基于两反应物 USPTO 数据和离线 Top-k 指标，真实实验可合成性仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 逆合成预测是计算机辅助合成规划的核心任务，可合成性仍是 AI 驱动分子和材料发现中的持续瓶颈。我们提出 RetroMol，一系列紧凑的基于文本的模型，将基于能量的批评器对候选反应物集合的排序转移到生成器本身。RetroBase 是一个 1100 万参数的 transformer 编码器—解码器，在双反应物 USPTO 反应上训练，在留出测试划分上的 Top-1 和 Top-5 准确率分别达到 46.8% 和 67.8%。RetroERM 是一个基于分子指纹计数的能量模型，用于给 RetroBase 的候选打分；随后将其排序偏好蒸馏回生成器。在相同数据和评估条件下，蒸馏模型 RetroDistil 的 Top-1 和 Top-5 分别达到 52.6% 和 73.5%，在 Top-1/3/5 上较 RetroBase 提高 5.7–6.8 个百分点，推理时无需重排序阶段，也不增加模型规模。因此，蒸馏批评器是一种实用方法，可在不采用更大或更复杂架构的情况下改进紧凑型逆合成生成器。
items.author_line: Rudra Sondhi, Edwin Chacko, Rodrigo A. Vargas-Hernández

items.title: Green synthesis of silver nanoparticles from Artemisia afra and Artemisia annua leaf extracts: Enhanced in vitro anthelmintic activity against Haemonchus contortus
items.abstract_or_text: Rising anthelmintic resistance in Haemonchus contortus and other gastrointestinal nematodes poses a critical challenge to livestock parasite management, underscoring the urgent need for novel therapeutic agents. This study evaluated the in vitro anthelmintic potential of green-synthesized silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) derived from Artemisia afra and Artemisia annua leaf extracts against adult worms. Aqueous leaf extracts were utilized to biosynthesize AgNPs by optimizing reaction parameters, including extract-to-silver nitrate ratio, concentration, pH, and incubation time. Phytochemical characterization identified alkaloids, coumarins, tannins, polyphenols, and saponins in both species, with A. afra demonstrating markedly higher total phenolic (282 mg GAE/g) and flavonoid (3655.56 mg QE/g) contents than A. annua. UV-Vis spectroscopy confirmed nanoparticle synthesis, exhibiting characteristic surface plasmon resonance peaks at 435 nm (A. afra-AgNPs) and 456 nm (A. annua-AgNPs). Anthelmintic efficacy was assessed using the Adult Worm Motility Assay across a concentration gradient (3-48 microg/mL) over 24 hours. Both AgNP formulations displayed dose-dependent inhibition of motility. Notably, A. afra-AgNPs exhibited superior potency, achieving lower IC50; values at 12 hours compared to A. annua-AgNPs and the commercial anthelmintic levamisole. At 48 microg/mL (12 hours), A. afra-AgNPs demonstrated significantly greater motility inhibition than A. annua-AgNPs, while surpassing levamisole at 12 microg/mL (18 hours). These findings highlight green-synthesized AgNPs from Artemisia species, particularly A. afra, as potent, eco-friendly nano-anthelmintic candidates, offering a sustainable approach to mitigate drug-resistant nematode infections in livestock.
items.summary_zh: 以 Artemisia afra 和 Artemisia annua 叶提取物绿色合成 AgNPs，并在 Haemonchus contortus 成虫体外运动抑制实验中比较其剂量依赖的驱虫活性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将植物提取物绿色合成纳米颗粒与耐药寄生虫控制联系起来，并与 levamisole 做了比较。证据仍局限于体外成虫实验，粒径、批次稳定性、毒理和体内疗效尚未充分说明。
items.abstract_zh: Haemonchus contortus 和其他胃肠道线虫不断上升的驱虫药耐药性，对牲畜寄生虫管理构成关键挑战，凸显了开发新型治疗药物的迫切需求。本研究评估了由 Artemisia afra 和 Artemisia annua 叶提取物绿色合成的银纳米颗粒（AgNPs）对成虫的体外驱虫潜力。研究使用水性叶提取物，通过优化提取物与硝酸银比例、浓度、pH 和孵育时间等反应参数来生物合成 AgNPs。植物化学表征在两个物种中均鉴定出生物碱、香豆素、鞣质、多酚和皂苷；其中 A. afra 的总酚含量（282 mg GAE/g）和总黄酮含量（3655.56 mg QE/g）明显高于 A. annua。UV-Vis 光谱证实了纳米颗粒的合成，并显示 A. afra-AgNPs 和 A. annua-AgNPs 分别在 435 nm 和 456 nm 处出现特征性表面等离子体共振峰。采用 Adult Worm Motility Assay，在 3-48 microg/mL 的浓度梯度和 24 h 时间范围内评估驱虫效力。两种 AgNP 配方均表现出剂量依赖性的运动抑制。值得注意的是，与 A. annua-AgNPs 和商业驱虫药 levamisole 相比，A. afra-AgNPs 在 12 h 达到了更低的 IC50 值。在 48 microg/mL、12 h 条件下，A. afra-AgNPs 的运动抑制显著强于 A. annua-AgNPs；在 12 microg/mL、18 h 条件下，其效果超过 levamisole。这些发现表明，来自 Artemisia 物种、尤其是 A. afra 的绿色合成 AgNPs 是有潜力的高效、环保纳米驱虫候选物，为缓解牲畜耐药线虫感染提供了可持续路径。
items.author_line: Evouna, M. I. D., Bogning Zangueu, C., Ntoumba, A. A., Djimefo, A. K. T., Eya'ane Meva, F.

items.title: 3H-1,5-Benzodiazepine Derivatives as Novel Antimalarial Agents: Synthesis, Biological Evaluation and Computational Target Exploration
items.abstract_or_text: Malaria remains a major global health challenge worldwide and the emergence of resistance to frontline antimalarial drugs, including artemisinin-based combination therapies, underscores the need for novel antimalarial agents with distinct mechanism of action. Herein, eighteen novel 3H-1,5-benzodiazepine derivatives (5a-r) were synthesized and evaluated against chloroquine-sensitive (PfD10) and chloroquine resistant (PfW2) strains of Plasmodium falciparum. Cytotoxicity was assessed against human hepatocellular carcinoma (HepG2) cells to determine preliminary selectivity. Compound 5e, 5k, 5m, 5n, and 5o exhibited promising anti-plasmodial activity. Compound 5o was the most potent, with IC50 values of 5.88 ± 0.36 and 6.68 ± 2.03 µM against PfD10 and PfW2, respectively, whereas 5k and 5n displayed the most favourable selectivity profiles. Considering the potency of compounds 5k and 5o, we further evaluated them against human G9a, a histone lysine methyltransferase which showed exhibited weak inhibition relative to the reference inhibitor BIX-01294. Computational studies that include frontier molecular orbital analysis, molecular docking, MM-GBSA calculations, molecular dynamics simulations and post-simulation analyses were performed to support their binding modes and stability within the active sites of parasite-specific PfSET3 and human G9a. Thus, this study identifies 3H-1,5-benzodiazepine scaffold as a promising and underexplored starting point for new antimalarial agents, with PfSET3 emerging as an interesting target worth further investigation.
items.summary_zh: 合成18种 3H-1,5-benzodiazepine 衍生物，在氯喹敏感和耐药的 Plasmodium falciparum 株系中测试抗疟活性，并结合 G9a/PfSET3 计算分析探索靶点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了一个未充分探索的抗疟骨架，并同时给出细胞活性、初步选择性和多种计算结合分析。需要注意该工作仍是早期先导发现，G9a 抑制较弱，体内药效和作用机制尚未确证。
items.abstract_zh: 疟疾仍是全球主要健康挑战，且包括基于青蒿素的联合疗法在内的一线抗疟药出现耐药性，凸显了开发具有不同作用机制的新型抗疟药物的必要性。在本研究中，合成了 18 种新型 3H-1,5-benzodiazepine 衍生物（5a-r），并在氯喹敏感的（PfD10）和氯喹耐药的（PfW2）Plasmodium falciparum 株系中进行评估。研究还在人体肝细胞癌 HepG2 细胞中评估细胞毒性，以确定初步选择性。化合物 5e、5k、5m、5n 和 5o 表现出有希望的抗疟原虫活性。化合物 5o 的活性最强，对 PfD10 和 PfW2 的 IC50 值分别为 5.88 ± 0.36 和 6.68 ± 2.03 µM；而 5k 和 5n 表现出最有利的选择性特征。鉴于化合物 5k 和 5o 的活性，我们进一步在人体 G9a（一种组蛋白赖氨酸甲基转移酶）上对其进行评估；相对于参考抑制剂 BIX-01294，它们显示出较弱的抑制作用。研究还进行了前线分子轨道分析、分子对接、MM-GBSA 计算、分子动力学模拟和模拟后分析，以支持这些化合物在寄生虫特异性 PfSET3 和人体 G9a 活性位点内的结合模式与稳定性。因此，本研究将 3H-1,5-benzodiazepine 骨架确定为开发新型抗疟药物的有前景且尚未充分探索的起点，并提出 PfSET3 是值得进一步研究的靶点。
items.author_line: Pranali Vijaykumar Kuthe, Mohammed Muzaffar-Ur-Rehman, Abirla Murugan, Mina Rashid, Nicoletta Basilico, Sajad Hussain Syed, Kondapalli Venkata Gowri Chandra Sekhar, Sankaranarayanan Murugesan, Murugesan Sankaran

items.title: Alkyl-BODIPYs as a Self-Photoredox Catalyst for their Oxidative Hydroxymethylation
items.abstract_or_text: The adoption of photocatalytic approaches for utilising small organic molecules in self‑catalysed reactions offers opportunities in green organic synthesis. We report that alkylated boron‑dipyrromethenes (BODIPYs) act as self‑photoredox catalysts for their own oxidation under mild visible‑light conditions. Using an imidazolinium salt (NHC-H) as a quencher, alkylated BODIPYs are oxidised cleanly to the corresponding hydroxymethyl derivatives in a one‑pot process. Luminescence studies, including Stern–Volmer analysis, support a reductive‑quenching pathway in which the NHC-H transfers an electron to photoexcited BODIPY to give a BODIPY radical anion. The method proceeds without external photocatalysts or stoichiometric oxidants and shows good functional‑group tolerance, highlighting the potential of these chromophores both as substrates and catalytic light absorbers. Moreover, the synthesized molecules were demonstrated to behave as effective passivating agents for layered Mn2+
items.summary_zh: 报道烷基化 BODIPYs 在温和可见光条件下作为自身氧化的自光氧化还原催化剂，并通过 NHC-H 猝灭剂实现一锅羟甲基化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把底物与光氧化还原催化剂角色合并，避免外加光催化剂和化学计量氧化剂，并显示较好的官能团兼容性。摘要未给出完整产率、底物范围和后续 Mn2+ 钝化结果，且仍需规模化与机理复核。
items.abstract_zh: 采用光催化方法利用小有机分子进行自催化反应，为绿色有机合成提供了机会。我们报道，烷基化 boron-dipyrromethenes（BODIPYs）在温和的可见光条件下可作为自身氧化的自光氧化还原催化剂。使用咪唑啉鎓盐（NHC-H）作为猝灭剂，烷基化 BODIPYs 可在一锅过程中被干净地氧化为相应的羟甲基衍生物。包括 Stern–Volmer 分析在内的发光研究支持还原猝灭途径：NHC-H 向光激发的 BODIPY 转移一个电子，形成 BODIPY 自由基阴离子。该方法无需外加光催化剂或化学计量氧化剂，并表现出良好的官能团耐受性，突出了这些发色团兼具底物和催化光吸收剂的潜力。此外，所合成分子还被证明可作为层状 Mn2+ 的有效钝化剂。
items.author_line: Shaista Sultan, Praveen B. Managutti, Ahmed Abdelhady, Ramon Rios

items.title: Are Molecular Foundation Models Ready for Free Energy Simulations?
items.abstract_or_text: Foundation models for atomistic simulations offer broadly applicable potentialenergy surfaces that can either be applied in a zero-shot manner (without domainspecific retraining) or fine-tuned to the task at hand. Their accuracy is typically judged by energy and force errors on near-equilibrium data, yet it remains largely unclear whether these metrics translate into reliable free-energy landscapes. Here, enhanced sampling can be a particularly demanding test: simulations are driven far from equilibrium into sparsely trained regions and held there over long trajectories, so that small systematic errors in forces or relative energies can accumulate and distort predicted populations, transition pathways, and barriers. We assess several molecular foundation models trained on different dataset sizes and architectures (including models with explicit long-range electrostatics) in prototypical metadynamics and umbrella sampling simulations. Our results show that recent foundation models can reproduce simple gas-phase free-energy profiles with near-reference accuracy, while more complex multidimensional and solvated free-energy landscapes remain challenging. However, assessing their performance in these systems is further complicated by limitations in current sampling protocols and the lack of well-defined reference data. These findings highlight the need for more rigorous sampling protocols and reliable benchmarks to systematically assess the accuracy of future molecular foundation models in free-energy calculations.
items.summary_zh: 系统评估不同分子基础模型在 metadynamics 和 umbrella sampling 自由能模拟中的表现，发现简单气相剖面可接近参考结果，但溶剂化、多维景观仍具挑战。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把近平衡能量/力误差与长时间增强采样中的自由能可靠性区分开来，为分子基础模型建立更严格的验证标准。研究也指出采样协议和参考数据不足会限制结论。
items.abstract_zh: 用于原子级模拟的基础模型提供了广泛适用的势能面，可以零样本方式（无需领域特异性再训练）应用，也可以针对任务进行微调。它们的精度通常依据近似平衡数据上的能量和力误差来判断，但这些指标是否能转化为可靠的自由能景观，仍很不明确。在这方面，增强采样尤其是严格的测试：模拟会被驱动到远离平衡且训练数据稀疏的区域，并在长轨迹中保持在那里，因此力或相对能量中的微小系统误差会累积，进而扭曲预测的布居、转变路径和势垒。我们在原型 metadynamics 和 umbrella sampling 模拟中评估了多个分子基础模型；这些模型采用不同数据集规模和架构训练，其中包括显式表示长程静电作用的模型。结果显示，近期基础模型能够以接近参考的精度重现简单气相自由能剖面，但更复杂的多维和溶剂化自由能景观仍然具有挑战性。然而，当前采样协议的局限以及缺少定义明确的参考数据，也使这些体系中的性能评估更加复杂。这些发现强调，需要更严格的采样协议和更可靠的基准，以系统评估未来分子基础模型在自由能计算中的准确性。
items.author_line: Nils Gönnheimer, Karsten Reuter, Johannes T. Margraf

items.title: Microstructural, Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy, and Fourier-Transform Infrared Analysis of Inorganic-Platelet Polymer Composites for Sustainable Infrastructure
items.abstract_or_text: Polymer matrix composites used in wet or thermally variable environments may change through moisture diffusion, polymer relaxation, swelling and plasticization, hydrolysis or leaching, microcracking, and progressive weakening of the reinforcement–matrix interface. This paper focuses on understanding the composition and morphology of a reinforcing phase, and determining whether its incorporation produces additional bulk-resolvable chemical features, which is important for interpreting composites used in wet or aggressive environments. The study presents a structural and spectroscopic characterization of a commercial glass-flake-reinforced unsaturated-polyester composite by combining energydispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) with full-range Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) against a neat unsaturated-polyester-resin control. EDS gives a composition consistent with a sodium–calcium silicate glass phase for the flake (17.4 wt% Si, 5.0 wt% Na, 2.2 wt% Ca, 1.1 wt% Al, 1.0 wt% Mg and 55.6 wt% O), whereas the polyester matrix and coat regions are dominated by carbon and oxygen (70–75 wt% C and 23–26 wt% O). Two representative flakes (n = 2) have apparent length-to-width ratios of 21.9 and 43.9. FTIR spectra collected over 428–4500 cm-1 show the same principal polyester-resin-associated bands at essentially identical wavenumbers in the composite and neat resin. Polymer-associated band intensities are 12–28% lower in the composite, while the band near the Si–O–Si network bending region changes by only −0.6%. No additional resolvable bulk absorption bands are observed. The results support a physically dispersed silicate-glass phase within the polyester matrix but do not exclude weak or spatially localized interfacial interactions below the resolution of the measurements. The spectra and elemental tables are released as a reusable dataset.
items.summary_zh: 用 EDS 和全范围 FTIR 对玻璃鳞片增强不饱和聚酯复合材料进行微结构和化学表征，并发布可复用光谱与元素数据集。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为湿热和侵蚀环境下复合材料的成分、形貌及可分辨化学特征提供了基线数据。证据受限于仅分析 n = 2 个代表性鳞片，且未能排除低于分辨率的局部界面作用。
items.abstract_zh: 用于潮湿或温度变化环境的聚合物基复合材料，可能经历水分扩散、聚合物松弛、溶胀和增塑、水解或浸出、微裂纹，以及增强相—基体界面的逐步弱化。本研究聚焦于理解增强相的组成和形貌，并确定其加入是否产生可由整体测量分辨的额外化学特征；这对于解释用于潮湿或侵蚀环境的复合材料十分重要。研究以商用玻璃鳞片增强不饱和聚酯复合材料为对象，将能量色散 X 射线光谱（EDS）与全范围傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）结合，并以纯不饱和聚酯树脂作为对照。EDS 显示，鳞片的组成与钠—钙硅酸盐玻璃相一致（17.4 wt% Si、5.0 wt% Na、2.2 wt% Ca、1.1 wt% Al、1.0 wt% Mg 和 55.6 wt% O）；聚酯基体和涂层区域则以碳和氧为主（70–75 wt% C 和 23–26 wt% O）。两个代表性鳞片（n = 2）的表观长宽比分别为 21.9 和 43.9。在 428–4500 cm-1 范围采集的 FTIR 光谱显示，复合材料和纯树脂在基本相同的波数处具有相同的主要聚酯树脂相关谱带。复合材料中聚合物相关谱带强度降低了 12–28%，而 Si–O–Si 网络弯曲区域附近的谱带仅变化 −0.6%。未观察到其他可分辨的整体吸收谱带。结果支持硅酸盐玻璃相物理分散在聚酯基体中，但不能排除低于测量分辨率的弱界面相互作用或局部界面相互作用。光谱和元素表已作为可复用数据集发布。

items.title: Synthesis of Amphiphilic Polymer Co-Networks via the Growth of a Living RAFT Network. Part III: Effect of DMSO Content
items.abstract_or_text: Owing to their distinctive nanophase-separated, co-continuous morphology, Amphiphilic polymer co-networks (APCNs) have attracted considerable attention in the past four decades. In 2024, a RAFT-mediated network growth strategy for the synthesis of APCNs was reported. This approach involves first preparing a parent RAFT network, typically a hydrophilic network containing dormant network-RAFT agents, followed by the diffusion and polymerization of hydrophobic monomers within the parent network. This process generates a secondary hydrophobic nanophase within the pre-existing hydrophilic continuous phase, yielding an amphiphilic polymer co-network that fulfils the defining structural characteristics of APCNs. This work reports a systematic study of the effect of DMSO content (10%, 50%, and 75%) on the synthesis of amphiphilic polymer co-networks (APCNs) using the above-mentioned RAFT-mediated network growth strategy. The resulting APCNs comprise a hydrophilic parent network based on oligo(ethylene glycol) methyl ether acrylate (OEGA, Mn = 480) and the crosslinker N, N′-methylenebisacrylamide (Bis), into which hydrophobic n-butyl acrylate (BA) segments are incorporated through RAFT-mediated network growth. Network chemical composition, thermal properties, and morphology were characterized using FT-IR, TGA, DSC, and SEM, while amphiphilicity was assessed through equilibrium swelling measurements in water and toluene. The DMSO content employed during parent network synthesis was found to exert a pronounced effect on the properties of the resulting APCNs. Among the systems investigated, the APCN derived from a parent gel prepared in 75% DMSO and subjected to 5 h of photogrowth exhibited the most balanced amphiphilic character, displaying swelling ratios of 10.30 in water and 18.24 in toluene.
items.summary_zh: 系统研究 DMSO 含量（10%、50%、75%）对 living RAFT 网络生长法制备两亲聚合物共网络的化学组成、热性质、形貌和溶胀行为的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 给出溶剂组成调控 APCN 两亲平衡的可操作窗口，并用 FT-IR、TGA、DSC、SEM 和溶胀测试进行多维表征。工作属于参数优化研究，性能与长期稳定性、应用场景之间的联系尚未建立。
items.abstract_zh: 由于具有独特的纳米相分离、共连续形貌，两亲聚合物共网络（APCN）在过去四十年中受到广泛关注。2024 年曾报道一种通过 RAFT 介导网络生长合成 APCN 的策略。该方法首先制备母体 RAFT 网络，通常是含有休眠网络 RAFT 试剂的亲水网络；随后疏水单体在母体网络中扩散并聚合。该过程在预先存在的亲水连续相内生成次级疏水纳米相，从而得到满足 APCN 定义结构特征的两亲聚合物共网络。本研究系统考察了 DMSO 含量（10%、50% 和 75%）对采用上述 RAFT 介导网络生长策略合成 APCN 的影响。所得 APCN 包含以 oligo(ethylene glycol) methyl ether acrylate（OEGA，Mn = 480）为基础、以 N, N′-methylenebisacrylamide（Bis）为交联剂的亲水母体网络；疏水 n-butyl acrylate（BA）链段通过 RAFT 介导网络生长嵌入其中。研究使用 FT-IR、TGA、DSC 和 SEM 表征网络化学组成、热性质和形貌，并通过在水和甲苯中的平衡溶胀测试评估两亲性。结果发现，母体网络合成时使用的 DMSO 含量会显著影响所得 APCN 的性质。在所研究的体系中，由 75% DMSO 制备的母体凝胶并进行 5 h 光生长得到的 APCN 表现出最平衡的两亲性，在水和甲苯中的溶胀比分别为 10.30 和 18.24。
items.author_line: Jingyao Zhai, Yueru Zhao, Yihan Zhang, Daniel Clyde, Jianyong Jin

items.title: Protein novelty, sequence similarity, and negative sampling controls reveal benchmark specific discrimination in protein protein interactionprediction
items.abstract_or_text: Protein protein interaction (PPI) predictors are often evaluated with random pair splits that permit proteins to recur across training and test sets, while constructed negative pairs can introduce a separate source of benchmark-specific signal. We reassessed the Guo yeast benchmark using a matched protein novelty curve, independently generated MMseqs2 sequence cluster controlled R3 variants, topology only controls, degree- and length matched putative negatives, handcrafted and frozen protein language model representations, multiple model configurations, seed analyses, and connected component aware inference. In the matched R1[->]R2[->]R3 comparison, AAC+CTD-MLP ROC-AUC declined from 0.697 for seen-seen pairs to 0.626 for one-unseen pairs and 0.587 for both-unseen pairs. Across independently regenerated cluster-disjoint R3 variants at 50%, 40%, 30%, and 20% MMseqs2 clustering thresholds, performance showed no consistent monotonic trend. Guo original-negative endpoints had lower positive-network degree than positive endpoints (mean 3.34 versus 6.72), and a degree-only logistic model reached ROC-AUC 0.962 on the original negatives but 0.502 on degree-matched negatives. We used degree-matched negatives consistently for R3 training and testing; six sequence based model configurations yielded ROC-AUC 0.493- 0.547; none showed corrected connected-component-aware evidence of above-chance discrimination. A PIPR multispecies analysis reproduced degree-associated label separation but also exposed cross-species pairing as an additional pooled cue. These results show that protein novelty, operational sequence cluster separation, and negative-set topology are distinct dimensions of PPI benchmark evaluation. The Guo result is benchmark-specific and should not be generalized to sequence-based PPI prediction or protein language models overall. The dataset and source code for the experiments are publicly available at https://github.com/morufwork/guoAudit.git.
items.summary_zh: 重新审查 Guo 酵母 PPI 基准，控制蛋白新颖性、序列聚类和负样本拓扑后，发现原始高性能主要来自基准特异性信号，而非可泛化的序列判别能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 直接揭示随机划分和负样本构造可能造成的虚高结果，并提供 MMseqs2 聚类、度匹配负样本和连通分量感知评估。结论针对 Guo 基准，不能外推为所有 PPI 或蛋白语言模型任务的结论。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质—蛋白质相互作用（PPI）预测器通常使用随机配对划分进行评估，这允许同一蛋白在训练集和测试集中重复出现；而构造的负配对还可能引入另一种基准特异性信号。我们重新评估了 Guo 酵母基准，采用匹配的蛋白新颖性曲线、独立生成的受 MMseqs2 序列聚类控制的 R3 变体、仅拓扑控制、度和长度匹配的候选负样本、手工设计和冻结的蛋白语言模型表示、多种模型配置、种子分析，以及连通分量感知推断。在匹配的 R1→R2→R3 比较中，AAC+CTD-MLP 的 ROC-AUC 从已见—已见配对的 0.697，下降到一方未见配对的 0.626，再下降到双方未见配对的 0.587。在 50%、40%、30% 和 20% MMseqs2 聚类阈值下独立重新生成的簇不相交 R3 变体中，性能没有显示一致的单调趋势。Guo 原始负样本的端点具有更低的正网络度数，正端点的平均度数为 3.34，而原始负样本为 6.72；仅基于度数的逻辑回归模型在原始负样本上达到 ROC-AUC 0.962，但在度匹配负样本上为 0.502。我们在 R3 训练和测试中始终使用度匹配负样本；六种基于序列的模型配置得到的 ROC-AUC 为 0.493-0.547；经校正的连通分量感知分析没有一种显示出高于随机水平的证据。PIPR 多物种分析重现了与度数相关的标签分离，但还暴露出跨物种配对是合并数据中的另一种线索。这些结果表明，蛋白质新颖性、操作性序列聚类分离和负集合拓扑是 PPI 基准评估中的不同维度。Guo 结果具有基准特异性，不应推广到基于序列的 PPI 预测或蛋白语言模型整体。实验数据集和源代码已公开于 https://github.com/morufwork/guoAudit.git。
items.author_line: Adeagbo, M. A., Agbaje, H. A., Silveira, S. A.
